title: Truth at the origin, everyone else reads it
description: The project's own site is the only authority. Clients, indexes and mirrors are readers.

nodes.title: Project repository
nodes.detail: index.md, mod.toml, mod.lock and the mod's files, reviewed in git.

nodes.title: Static mod site
nodes.detail: The page people read, plus dreamweave.json and one manifest per project.

nodes.title: Clients
nodes.detail: CHIMERA or anything else: discover, pick a release, verify, install.

nodes.title: Indexes
nodes.detail: St4sh or a community list: crawl, cache, search. Never the only copy.

nodes.title: Mirrors and caches
nodes.detail: Serve bytes by SHA-256. Never trusted, always verified.
